fact.en: A mixture is two or more substances put together physically, not chemically combined, so they can be separated again by physical means.
fact.tl: Ang mixture ay dalawa o higit pang substances na pinagsama nang pisikal, hindi chemically combined, kaya maaari silang paghiwalayin muli sa pisikal na paraan.
fact.bis: Ang mixture mao ang duha o daghan pang substances nga gisagol sa pisikal nga paagi, dili chemically combined, busa mahimo silang bulagon pag-usab pinaagi sa pisikal nga paagi.

cards.illustration: A child's hands holding a bowl of mixed nuts and raisins, showing different pieces side by side.

fact.en:
If I mix sand and sugar, did I make a new substance?

No! The sand and sugar stay as themselves. You can still see the sand grains and taste the sugar, so no new substance was formed.
fact.tl:
Kung hinalo ko ang buhangin at asukal, nakagawa ba ako ng bagong substance?

Hindi! Nanatili pa ring buhangin at asukal ang mga ito. Makikita mo pa rin ang mga butil ng buhangin at malalasahan ang asukal, kaya walang bagong substance na nabuo.
fact.bis:
Kung gisagol nako ang balas ug asukar, nakahimo ba ko ug bag-ong substance?

Dili! Nagpabilin nga balas ug asukar ang mga ini. Makita pa nimo ang mga lugas sa balas ug matilawan ang asukar, busa walay bag-ong substance nga nahimo.

cards.illustration: A close-up of sand grains and white sugar crystals mixed together in a clear bowl.

fact.en: In a homogeneous mixture, the composition looks the same throughout, so you cannot tell one component apart from another.
fact.tl: Sa homogeneous mixture, pareho ang itsura ng komposisyon sa buong bahagi, kaya hindi mo mapaghihiwalay ang isang component sa iba.
fact.bis: Sa homogeneous mixture, pareho ang hitsura sa tibuok nga parte, busa dili nimo mailhan ang usa ka component sa lain.

cards.illustration: A glass of clear vinegar and water mixture that looks like one single liquid.

fact.en: In a heterogeneous mixture, the composition is not uniform, so you can easily see and distinguish the different components.
fact.tl: Sa heterogeneous mixture, hindi pareho ang komposisyon, kaya madali mong makikita at makikilala ang iba't ibang components.
fact.bis: Sa heterogeneous mixture, dili pareho ang komposisyon, busa dali nimo makita ug mailhan ang lain-laing components.

cards.illustration: A bowl of fruit salad with visible chunks of apple, papaya, and banana.

fact.en: A solid-solid mixture combines two or more different solids, like cake mix, fruit salad, or mixed nuts.
fact.tl: Ang solid-solid mixture ay pinagsamang dalawa o higit pang magkakaibang solids, tulad ng cake mix, fruit salad, o mixed nuts.
fact.bis: Ang solid-solid mixture mao ang gisagol nga duha o daghan pang lain-laing solids, sama sa cake mix, fruit salad, o mixed nuts.

cards.illustration: A bowl of mixed nuts with almonds, cashews, and peanuts clearly visible.

fact.en:
What happens when I mix sand and water?

The heavier sand particles settle at the bottom! This is a solid-liquid mixture where the solid and liquid separate.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag hinalo ko ang buhangin at tubig?

Ang mas mabibigat na butil ng buhangin ay lulubog sa ilalim! Ito ay solid-liquid mixture kung saan naghihiwalay ang solid at liquid.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung gisagol nako ang balas ug tubig?

Ang mas bug-at nga mga lugas sa balas mahimutang sa ilawom! Kini usa ka solid-liquid mixture diin nagbulag ang solid ug liquid.

cards.illustration: A clear glass of water with sand settled at the bottom and clear water above.

fact.en: A liquid-liquid mixture combines two or more different liquids, such as vinegar and water, soy sauce and vinegar, or oil and water.
fact.tl: Ang liquid-liquid mixture ay pinagsamang dalawa o higit pang magkakaibang liquids, tulad ng suka at tubig, toyo at suka, o mantika at tubig.
fact.bis: Ang liquid-liquid mixture mao ang gisagol nga duha o daghan pang lain-laing liquids, sama sa suka ug tubig, toyo ug suka, o mantika ug tubig.

cards.illustration: A clear glass showing oil floating as a yellow layer on top of water.

fact.en:
Why don't oil and water mix?

Oil and water do not stick to each other! The oil stays as a separate layer and floats on top because it is lighter than water.
fact.tl:
Bakit hindi naghahalo ang mantika at tubig?

Hindi magkadikit ang mantika at tubig! Nananatiling hiwalay na layer ang mantika at lumulutang sa itaas dahil mas magaan ito kaysa tubig.
fact.bis:
Ngano dili magsagol ang mantika ug tubig?

Dili magdikit ang mantika ug tubig! Magpabilin nga lahi nga layer ang mantika ug molutaw sa taas kay mas gaan kini kaysa tubig.

cards.illustration: A glass with a yellow oil layer floating on top of clear water, showing a clear boundary.

fact.en: Air is a mixture of different gases, so even though you cannot see them, they are physically combined and can be separated.
fact.tl: Ang hangin ay mixture ng iba't ibang gases, kaya kahit hindi mo sila nakikita, sila ay physically combined at maaaring paghiwalayin.
fact.bis: Ang hangin usa ka mixture sa lain-laing gases, busa bisan dili nimo sila makita, sila physically combined ug mahimo nga bulagon.

cards.illustration: A blue sky with wispy clouds, representing the invisible mixture of gases in the air.

fact.en: Halo-halo is a heterogeneous mixture because you can easily see and distinguish its many different ingredients like beans, fruit, and ice.
fact.tl: Ang halo-halo ay heterogeneous mixture dahil madali mong makikita at makikilala ang maraming iba't ibang sangkap nito tulad ng beans, prutas, at yelo.
fact.bis: Ang halo-halo usa ka heterogeneous mixture kay dali nimo makita ug mailhan ang daghan nga lain-laing sagol sama sa beans, prutas, ug yelo.

cards.illustration: A tall glass of halo-halo with visible layers of beans, fruit, and shaved ice.

cards.topic: Pure Water Is Not a Mixture

fact.en:
Is pure water a mixture?

No! Pure water is just one substance, not two or more substances combined, so it is not a mixture.
fact.tl:
Ang purong tubig ba ay mixture?

Hindi! Ang purong tubig ay iisang substance lamang, hindi dalawa o higit pang substances na pinagsama, kaya hindi ito mixture.
fact.bis:
Ang purong tubig ba usa ka mixture?

Dili! Ang purong tubig usa lang ka substance, dili duha o daghan pang substances nga gisagol, busa dili kini mixture.

title.en: Pure Water Is Not a Mixture

cards.illustration: A clear glass of pure water with nothing else in it.

fact.en: Carbon is a single substance, not a mixture, because it is made of only one kind of matter.
fact.tl: Ang carbon ay iisang substance, hindi mixture, dahil gawa ito sa iisang uri lamang ng matter.
fact.bis: Ang carbon usa lang ka substance, dili mixture, kay gihimo kini sa usa lang ka klase sa matter.

cards.illustration: A piece of black carbon, like charcoal, shown as a single solid material.

fact.en:
Can I separate the parts of a mixture?

Yes! Because mixtures are only physically combined, you can separate them by physical means like picking, filtering, or letting solids settle.
fact.tl:
Maaari ko bang paghiwalayin ang mga bahagi ng mixture?

Oo! Dahil ang mixtures ay physically combined lamang, maaari mong paghiwalayin ang mga ito sa pisikal na paraan tulad ng pagpili, pagsala, o pagpapalubog ng solids.
fact.bis:
Mahimo ba nako nga bulagon ang mga parte sa mixture?

Oo! Kay ang mixtures physically combined lamang, mahimo nimo silang bulagon sa pisikal nga paagi sama sa pagpili, pagsala, o pagpahimutang sa solids.

cards.illustration: A child using a strainer to separate rice grains from water.

fact.en: Vinegar and water form a homogeneous mixture because they mix completely and look like one single liquid.
fact.tl: Ang suka at tubig ay bumubuo ng homogeneous mixture dahil ganap silang naghahalo at mukhang iisang liquid lamang.
fact.bis: Ang suka ug tubig nagporma ug homogeneous mixture kay hingpit silang nagsagol ug morag usa lang ka liquid.

cards.illustration: A clear glass of vinegar and water mixture that looks like one transparent liquid.

fact.en:
Why can I see the different fruits in a fruit salad?

Because fruit salad is a heterogeneous mixture! Its components are not uniform, so each fruit stays visible and easy to distinguish.
fact.tl:
Bakit nakikita ko ang iba't ibang prutas sa fruit salad?

Dahil ang fruit salad ay heterogeneous mixture! Hindi pareho ang mga components nito, kaya nananatiling nakikita at madaling makilala ang bawat prutas.
fact.bis:
Ngano makita nako ang lain-laing prutas sa fruit salad?

Kay ang fruit salad usa ka heterogeneous mixture! Dili pareho ang mga components kini, busa magpabilin nga makita ug dali mailhan ang matag prutas.

cards.illustration: A bowl of fruit salad with distinct pieces of apple, banana, and papaya.

cards.topic: Cake Mix Is a Solid-Solid Mixture

fact.en: Cake mix is a solid-solid mixture because it combines different dry solid ingredients like flour, sugar, and baking powder.
fact.tl: Ang cake mix ay solid-solid mixture dahil pinagsasama nito ang iba't ibang tuyong solid ingredients tulad ng harina, asukal, at baking powder.
fact.bis: Ang cake mix usa ka solid-solid mixture kay gisagol kini sa lain-laing uga nga solid ingredients sama sa harina, asukar, ug baking powder.

cards.illustration: A bowl of dry cake mix powder with a whisk resting in it.

fact.en:
Is a coffee drink a mixture?

Yes! Coffee powder is a solid and water is a liquid, so when you mix them, you make a solid-liquid mixture.
fact.tl:
Ang kape ba ay mixture?

Oo! Ang coffee powder ay solid at ang tubig ay liquid, kaya kapag hinalo mo sila, nakagawa ka ng solid-liquid mixture.
fact.bis:
Ang kape ba usa ka mixture?

Oo! Ang coffee powder usa ka solid ug ang tubig usa ka liquid, busa kung gisagol nimo sila, nakahimo ka ug solid-liquid mixture.

cards.illustration: A cup of coffee with coffee powder being stirred into hot water.

fact.en: Beans and rice grains form a solid-solid mixture because both are solids that stay separate and can be easily distinguished.
fact.tl: Ang beans at butil ng bigas ay bumubuo ng solid-solid mixture dahil pareho silang solids na nananatiling hiwalay at madaling makilala.
fact.bis: Ang beans ug mga lugas sa bugas nagporma ug solid-solid mixture kay pareho silang solids nga magpabilin nga bulag ug dali mailhan.

cards.illustration: A bowl with red beans and white rice grains mixed together, each type clearly visible.

fact.en:
What happens when salt dissolves in water?

The salt seems to disappear! The two substances appear as one, so salt water is a homogeneous mixture.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag natunaw ang asin sa tubig?

Parang nawawala ang asin! Ang dalawang substances ay mukhang iisa, kaya ang tubig na may asin ay homogeneous mixture.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung matunaw ang asin sa tubig?

Morag mawala ang asin! Ang duha ka substances morag usa, busa ang tubig nga may asin usa ka homogeneous mixture.

cards.illustration: A glass of water with salt being poured in and dissolving until it looks clear.

fact.en: Milk and sugar form a solid-liquid mixture because sugar is a solid that dissolves into the liquid milk.
fact.tl: Ang gatas at asukal ay bumubuo ng solid-liquid mixture dahil ang asukal ay solid na natutunaw sa liquid na gatas.
fact.bis: Ang gatas ug asukar nagporma ug solid-liquid mixture kay ang asukar usa ka solid nga matunaw sa liquid nga gatas.

cards.illustration: A glass of milk with sugar being stirred in with a spoon.
